implementation_summary: DEC-005 correction. buildRoadmapDocument now sets doc.language to lookup.requested ?? lookup.language, so a Hindi/Telugu request that falls back to English labels keeps the requested language on the document. Wording still comes from roadmapWording(lookup.language), so renderers show English text and no English 'Beta translation' note is mismatched. The fallback test in audit-doc-roadmap.test.ts now expects doc.language 'te'; all other assertions are unchanged.
risks: pnpm build not run; the ?? on the non-nullable requested field relies on TypeScript accepting it (expected to be fine).

Renderers that key the beta note off doc.language may now see 'te' with English text; the beta note text for 'te' is in English only while the fallback applies. Reviewer should confirm the renderer path (documentBetaNote) for unsupported languages.
handoff: Documents for unsupported languages now carry the requested language code while their wording is English. Any consumer that uses doc.language to choose a label table must use labelsFor(...).language, not doc.language.
